title: Authorized access
text: The LabQC Connect system shall allow only authorized laboratory staff to access QC data.

title: Automatic data collection
text: The LabQC Connect system shall collect QC results from connected analyzers automatically.

title: Rule violation alerts
text: When a QC result violates the laboratory's QC rules, the LabQC Connect system shall alert laboratory staff.

title: LIS reporting
text: The LabQC Connect system shall send accepted QC results to the laboratory information system.

title: QC trends
text: The LabQC Connect system shall show QC performance trends over time.

title: QC material lots
text: The LabQC Connect system shall track QC material lots and their expiry dates.

title: Audit trail
text: The LabQC Connect system shall keep a complete audit trail of user actions and data transmissions.

title: Peer comparison
text: The LabQC Connect system shall allow laboratory staff to compare QC performance with peer laboratories.
